power.jaymospowers.web.desc: Swing on one web or two. Both webs out + Sneak: slingshot (hold Jump to draw). Hold Jump in mid-air: web wings (Sneak while gliding to airbrake). Sprint and leap alongside a wall to run along it; Jump kicks off it, higher as you master the power.
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_1: Hold: main-hand web swing (release on the upswing for a boost)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_2: Hold: off-hand web swing (empty off hand)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_3: Tap: web pellet. Hold, then let go: web blast (Slowness III + cobwebs)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_4: Tap: Yank. Hold: web lead; let go aimed at a block to hitch it there
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ultimate: Web Strike: zip to what you aim at and kick it
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.edge: It's had almost enough of you.
message.jaymospowers.web_ascend.0: The air hums against the back of your neck.
message.jaymospowers.web_ascend.1: The hum sharpens into a tingle.
power.jaymospowers.web.key.starter: Hold on one block, let go on another: a walkable webline
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.instin: Tendrils burst from your back before you can think. It wants to live.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.sulk: You let it starve. It tears itself off you, seething.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.sulkin: It won't come. It's still angry with you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.sulk_o: It creeps back to you, calmer now.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.inedib: It recoils. It won't touch that.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.rip: Walls won't stop it. It tears through.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.stress: It shifts under your skin, restless.
It's irritable. It doesn't like this.
It seethes. Something will have to give.
It hates you right now. It wants out, or it wants blood.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.flint: It SCREAMS. Not fire. Never fire.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.just_l: It sets them down. It was only looking.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.not_lo: It didn't like what it saw.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.defend: You're dying. It isn't. It takes over to save itself.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.flee: It vanishes into itself and RUNS. It will not die here.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.bulk_d: The bulk sinks back into the tendrils.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.neglec: You forget us. Fine. We do it our way now.
Ignored. Again. Then we take what we want.
You never listen to us. Now we don't listen to you.
Left to rot inside you. No more. Watch us.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.sated: Full. Quiet now. For a while.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.locked: It won't give you that. Not yet.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.resist: You fight it for your own limbs.
You pull against it. It doesn't even notice.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.break_: You wrench yourself back. It lets go, sullen.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.unlock: It trusts you with its tendrils now.
It will wear you, if you ask. Living Armor.
It teaches your hands to cling. Wall Crawl.
It will share a meal with you now. Consume.
It will bristle on command. Spike Burst.
Fully bonded. The great body is yours to move.
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_1.sym: Hold: swing on black rope. Living Armor: a tendril grabs a creature or item, let go to throw; Sneak at a block: it struggles, then tears out a chunk (click: charged swing; holding a corpse, click: thrash it)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_2.sym: Hold: off-hand swing. Living Armor: the other tendril grabs and throws; Sneak at a block: it struggles, then tears out a chunk
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_3.sym: Hold, then let go: a blast of black mass
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ability_4.sym: Tap: Yank. Hold: lead; let go aimed at a block to hitch it there. Further reach
power.jaymospowers.web.key.mode: Web Zip to where you aim (hold Sneak to land on it)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.mode.symbiote: Web Zip, further and quicker to recover (hold Sneak to land on it)
power.jaymospowers.web.key.special.symbi: Hold: the symbiote menu (mask, Tendril Grab, Living Armor, Wall Crawl, Consume, Spike Burst, Shroud; each unlocks as the bond grows, and the mask once 4 abilities have)
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.suit_l: Not yet. It won't wear itself for you until it trusts you. (Unlock 4 of its abilities.)
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.suit_w: It slides back under your skin. It will come again when it trusts you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.harden: It hardens over you like armour plate. Nothing gets through. Not yet.
NO NO NO. NOT LIKE THIS. MOVE.
WE ARE DYING. IT TAKES THE LEGS.
It screams inside your skull. RUN. RUN. RUN.
YOU WILL NOT DIE. WE WILL NOT DIE.
It tears the controls from you. Live first. Argue later.
Too much blood. Too much. It bolts.
Get away get away get away GET AWAY.
It won't lose another host. It takes you and flees.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.alarm_: FIRE! It shrieks and peels away from the heat!
It's BURNING! It thrashes and recoils from the flames!
The heat! It writhes and screams in your blood!
It shrinks from the fire, howling. GET AWAY FROM IT.
That sound! It shrieks and convulses under your skin!
The noise tears through it! It recoils, screaming!
It writhes at the sound. MAKE IT STOP.
It shudders off you at the noise, wailing!
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.st: The sky screams. We like it.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.ra: Wet. Cold on the skin we share.
Water from the sky. Strange world.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.de: Deep. Stone all around. It feels like home.
So far down. Nothing hears us here.
Dark and close. We like the deep.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.hi: The air is thin up here.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.ho: Hot. Too hot. It burns the skin.
The heat. We hate the heat.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.wa: We sink. We swim. Get out.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.vi: They stare at us. Let them.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.mo: Things that want us dead. Let them try.
Rot and bone nearby. We smell it.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.be: Animals. They know what we are.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.pl: Another of your kind. Watch them.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.co: A body. Still fresh. We could eat.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.see.la: Fire in the ground. Stay away.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.tour.v: Look. All of it, below us.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.tour.w: Water over there. We want to see it.
Deep water. What lives in it?
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.tour.v: Them. We want to look at them.
message.jaymospowers.web_counter.ready: Spider-Sense! Right click to counter (%s of %s charges left)
